name: Ferguson's Orchards Galesville
description: In Galesville, WI, Ferguson's Orchards Galesville raises Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
